text.en: Many clients commend Dr Robertson and Dr Roberts for their compassionate care, thorough clinical explanations, and patient approach. Pet owners value that the veterinary surgeons take time to listen and discuss medical decisions directly. However, several reviewers report encounters with an unfriendly receptionist and unhelpful front desk communication.

Consultations with the veterinary surgeons are praised for thorough advice, clear guidance, and thoughtful dialogue regarding treatment options. In contrast, multiple reviewers highlight significant difficulties reaching reception by telephone, citing delayed callbacks and unreturned messages. Client feedback regarding administrative communication remains divided.

Reviewers appreciate that clinic staff occasionally fit in pets with sudden injuries or urgent concerns on busy days. Conversely, clients mention waiting days for appointment scheduling callbacks and note that walk-in visits for sick pets are not accepted. Pet owners recommend booking well in advance rather than relying on same-day availability.

q.en: Does Midway Road Animal Clinic accept walk-in appointments?

a.en: Reviewers note that walk-in visits are generally declined, and clients are advised to book appointments in advance.

q.en: How do clients rate the veterinary care from the doctors?

a.en: Pet owners speak very highly of the veterinarians, praising their compassion, medical explanations, and personal attention.

q.en: Can urgent medical concerns be accommodated?

a.en: Clients report that the clinic has worked existing patients in for same-day evaluation when injuries occurred.

q.en: How are veterinary fees evaluated by clients?

a.en: Several reviewers note fair and reasonable pricing without unexpected or unnecessary add-on charges.
